name: Merge Dataset Array (Row Add/Update/Delete)
description: Operates on one row of an array-shaped (grid/detail) dataset by index. data:null at a given index DELETES that row; a data object at that index UPDATES or (if index is past the end, e.g. current listcount) ADDS a row.
sourceRefs: aoo-account-genral table method.json:1424-1474 (delete row, data: null, index: [this.propkey])

index.description: Binding expression for the target row index, e.g. "[this.propkey]" for the current row, or "[DsFrmDetails1(listcount)(+)raw.1(numformat)raw.0]" to append.

data.description: null deletes the row at index. An object adds/updates the row.
